C0635.title: Alibaba.com Duplicate Listing Identification and Handling Guidance
C0635.summary: An Alibaba.com Data Manager page explains that duplicate listings occur when a seller publishes the same product as multiple displayed items, and that products with identical or highly similar titles, descriptions, images, or attributes may be treated as duplicates. The page lists examples such as repeatedly publishing the same item after changing only nonessential fields, colors, sizes, or images, and advises sellers to delete confirmed duplicate products or optimize product information when the items are actually different.
